svg.aria-label: SEP CPU block diagram: the VeeR EL2 wrapper listing all configuration parameters, its local-alias remaps and demuxes, the TCM backdoor and memory export, and the module's control, interrupt, debug and status ports
svg.title: SEP CPU
svg.text: module sep_cpu · the VeeR EL2 wrapper with the parameters of the sep configuration snapshot
left: control, interrupt and debug inputs; right: the three AXI masters through their alias remaps and demuxes, the TCM export and every status output
instance names in monospace; the sans lines say what each element does
mux · demux: wide side = many ports
ID width in → out beneath the symbol
core clock, core reset, debugger reset
JTAG in (TDO and TDOEn leave on the right)
MPC halt / run handshake; the reset-run request is synchronised
255 external interrupt sources into the PIC (PIC_TOTAL_INT)
unused: RV_LOCKSTEP_ENABLE is not defined in this snapshot
32/64/6/12 · from the local crossbar target cpu_tcm (DMA backdoor into ICCM / DCCM)
alias window base for the three remaps (SEP_LOCAL_BASE_ADDR)
native memory · ICCM 256 KiB in 4 banks, DCCM 128 KiB in 2 banks, 7-bit ECC → u_sep_tcm_wrapper
instruction trace: insn, address, valid, exception, ecause, interrupt, tval
